newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady on Friday, capping a week of lackluster dealings, dealers said.
A Texas dealer noted only interest for the nearbys and no forward demand all week," he said.
Grain prices in the Southwest have come "unglued," he said. "Buyers are not interested in midds unless they are real cheap."
In the Carolinas, midds appeared to be more available for the nearbys, a dealer said. Spot Carolinas prices were unchanged, to bid at $95.00 a ton and offer at $105.00.

Northeastern mills were adding a little more run time this weekend. "But we probably will not see it next weekend," a Buffalo dealer said. "It is difficult to find a home for the extra feed that is on the market right now."
A St. Louis dealer said he saw a pickup in nearby demand in his area.
Some dealers expect Monday to be fairly quiet due to the observance of the U.S. Veterans Day holiday.
"It looks like we will have favorable weekend weather for harvesting progress," a Kansas dealer said. "Monday may be a light due to Veterans Day."
